# arin_org (Data Source)

Read an ARIN organization through Reg-RWS, including its address and POC links. The tax ID is sensitive and is stored in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
data "arin_org" "example" {
  handle = "FT-684"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Organization handle.

### Read-Only

- `accept_reassignments` (Boolean) accept reassignments returned by ARIN.
- `city` (String) city returned by ARIN.
- `comments` (List of String) Ordered lines of comments.
- `country_calling_code` (String) country calling code returned by ARIN.
- `country_code` (String) country code returned by ARIN.
- `country_code3` (String) country code3 returned by ARIN.
- `country_name` (String) country name returned by ARIN.
- `dba_name` (String) dba name returned by ARIN.
- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
- `poc_links` (Attributes List) poc links returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))
- `postal_code` (String) postal code returned by ARIN.
- `registration_date` (String) registration date returned by ARIN.
- `rwhois_url` (String) rwhois url returned by ARIN.
- `street_address` (List of String) Ordered lines of street address.
- `subdivision` (String) subdivision returned by ARIN.
- `tax_id` (String, Sensitive) tax id returned by ARIN.

<a id="nestedatt--poc_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poc_links`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) description returned by ARIN.
- `function` (String) function returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
